newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $1.6 bln for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $1.6 bln for Wednesday.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales for Wednesday are expected to total $1.667 billion in 29 offerings, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $418 million million in 14 sales. The largest is a $195 million North Carolina general obligation bond issue at 1100 EST.
Negotiated sales total $1.249 billion in 15 offerings. The largest is a $808 million New York City tax-exempt offering through Goldman Sachs & Co.
An additional $26.8 million in three deals are on the possible list, meaning underwriters have said they may price the deals sometime Wednesday depending on market conditions.
